text: Visitors have noted issues with crowding, especially during school group visits, which affected access to exhibits and overall flow. Several reviews criticized the heavy reliance on AI-driven interactive exhibits, describing them as lacking educational depth and not accessible to all visitors. Some found the lighting too dim and signage insufficient, making navigation difficult. While many appreciated the architecture and interactive elements, a number of visitors felt the historical interpretation did not provide enough detailed context about Theodore Roosevelt’s accomplishments. Parking and food services were mentioned but less frequently.
